description: x402 Conformance Suite: Batch x402 conformance check for CI: up to 10 URLs in one call, each checked for a real 402, a decodable PAYMENT-REQUIRED, complete accepts[], placeholder or type-name examples and the 8,190 B header limit; the reply is one pass/fail tally + finding codes a pipeline can gate on. Input: urls = JSON array of up to 10 absolute http(s) URLs, e.g. ["https://minia2a.uk/x402/mime-type"] (GET query `urls` or POST body {"urls": [...]}).
name: x402-conformance-suite
